decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The noise generated from the generators and air conditioning unit(s) should be inaudible when assessed from the nearest noise sensitive receptor

Condition : 4 - The level of noise emitted from the proposed generators and air conditioning unit(s), shall not be less than 10dB(A ) below the existing background noise levels (LAeq), when measured from the nearest noise sensitive receptor, over any 24 hour period'
description: Installation of 4 no. satellite dishes 3.7m in diameter, 2 no. generator units and 3 no. air condensors units on the roof, incorporating internal alteration on 2nd floor and undercroft area to the building     (ACOUSTIC  PLANS ADDED)
